name: DIAGONAL_STRIPES_BLACK_ON_WHITE_TALL
notes: Illust. D4-3A(L,R) 225x450 R25. (L): black 45-degree stripes descending to the right. The perpendicular chain is read literally, from the top-right corner inwards along the diagonal: white 71 (corner), black 64, white 64, then black/white 64 alternating (64 perpendicular = 90.51 along an edge, 71 = 100.41). The drawn image shows equal-width black and white stripes with larger whites at both corners, consistent with this reading. (R) is the mirror image. 2026-09-08 drawing check: stripes were three bands 64 perpendicular (90.5 horizontal) with 128 white between them, the first meeting the top edge at x 34.08.
